accounts.name: program_data
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority can create the config, so nobody can front-run the deployer.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer is not authorized for this action

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: program is paused

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: config parameter out of range

errors.name: InvalidRevealWindow
errors.msg: reveal window must be in (0, max_reveal_window_secs]

errors.name: InvalidCallerLock
errors.msg: caller lock is below the configured minimum

errors.name: VaultCapTooHigh
errors.msg: max vault exceeds the configured per-call cap

errors.name: StakeTooLow
errors.msg: caller stake is below the minimum share of max vault

errors.name: StakeAboveVault
errors.msg: caller stake exceeds max vault

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: WrongState
errors.msg: call is not in the required state

errors.name: DeadlinePassed
errors.msg: reveal deadline has passed

errors.name: DeadlineNotPassed
errors.msg: reveal deadline has not passed

errors.name: CallerCannotDeposit
errors.msg: caller cannot deposit into their own call

errors.name: DepositCapExceeded
errors.msg: per-follower deposit cap exceeded

errors.name: VaultCapExceeded
errors.msg: call vault cap exceeded

errors.name: HashMismatch
errors.msg: revealed (mint, pool, salt) does not match the commitment

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: mint account does not match the revealed mint

errors.name: NotDammPool
errors.msg: pool is not a DAMM v2 pool

errors.msg: pool does not trade exactly wSOL and the revealed mint

errors.name: PoolVaultMismatch
errors.msg: pool vault accounts do not match the pool state

errors.name: WrongTokenProgram
errors.msg: output token program does not own the mint

errors.name: MinOutZero
errors.msg: minimum_amount_out must be greater than zero

errors.name: NothingToSwap
errors.msg: nothing to swap

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: swap returned fewer tokens than minimum_amount_out

errors.name: InvalidImpact
errors.msg: max_impact_bps must be above zero and within the config ceiling

errors.name: PriceImpactExceeded
errors.msg: fill is worse than the pool spot price allows for this call

errors.name: PoolNotSeasoned
errors.msg: pool is disabled or was not live before the call opened

errors.name: PoolLiquidityUnlocked
errors.msg: pool has too little permanently locked liquidity

errors.name: PoolTooThin
errors.msg: swap is too large for the pool's wSOL reserve

errors.name: MintAuthorityLive
errors.msg: mint has a live mint or freeze authority

errors.msg: mint carries a token extension that can tax, freeze, hook or seize transfers

errors.name: SwapPartialFill
errors.msg: swap left wSOL unspent

errors.name: DepositTooSmall
errors.msg: deposit is below the minimum

errors.name: CallerLockActive
errors.msg: caller lock period has not elapsed

errors.name: AlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: already claimed

errors.name: FollowersRemain
errors.msg: follower positions remain

errors.name: NothingToSweep
errors.msg: nothing to sweep

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NotDbcPool
errors.msg: pool is not a Meteora DBC virtual pool

errors.name: DbcConfigMismatch
errors.msg: DBC config account does not match the pool state

errors.name: PoolMigrated
errors.msg: DBC pool has completed its curve or migrated

fields.name: max_impact_bps
docs: worst fill vs the pool spot price at reveal, fixed at open so followers see it before depositing

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: fee terms fixed at open: a later set_config never reprices a funded call

fields.name: min_locked_liquidity_bps
docs: pool must hold at least this share of its liquidity permanently locked

fields.name: max_swap_reserve_bps
docs: the swap may use at most this share of the pool's wSOL reserve
